 bet365 Nations League preview
 The Nations League returns this week, with our preview focusing on the match between England and Croatia.
 Nations League Preview – England vs Croatia: Thursday, 7.45pm
 England haven’t lost since the opening night of the group, when Spain won 3-2 at Wembley. Since then Thomas Tuchel’s side have won three on the spin without conceding, beating Czechia 2-0 away, Croatia 7-0 in Rijeka and Czechia again 3-0 at Wembley. That leaves them second on nine points with 14 goals scored and only three against, the best goal difference in Group A3.
 Croatia’s autumn has been a lot rougher. They sit third on three points, with one win from four, over Czechia. They lost 4-1 to Spain, were hammered by England and then went down 2-1 to Spain, which was at least a closer game. The Rijeka result has to hurt, and it was England’s biggest Nations League win.
 There’s plenty at stake for England, too. A draw would take them to 10 points, which Croatia and Czechia can’t reach, so a top-two finish and a March quarter-final would be secured.
 England only need a point, but we’d expect them to go looking for all three.
